# ECO-ASHREACTOR-STEPS — Adopt the full Ash.Reactor step DSL surface (incl. bulk + generic)

Research finding 5 (high confidence, 3-0, with the verification correction that Ash.Reactor ships inside the main ash package - no separate ash_reactor hex package exists): Ash.Reactor provides a step DSL entity per action type - create, update, destroy, read, read_one, load, generic, ash_step, plus bulk create/update/destroy - for orchestrating resource actions in Reactor workflows. ash_pplan's adapter (lib/ash_pplan/reactor/adapters/ash_reactor.ex) currently exercises :create/:read/:update/:destroy kinds; this order closes the gap to the full surface (read_one, load, generic, ash_step, bulk), each by adoption receipt or typed refusal.
